description.fun: Blacephalon is a clown-like Ultra Beast whose head is a ball of tiny sparks that it can take off and use as a weapon. It lures targets in with its silly walk, then suddenly blows its head up to startle them and steals their vitality while they're stunned. The colour of its sparks and stars changes with its mood.
description.guide: Blacephalon is a Fire- and Ghost-type Ultra Beast, codenamed UB Burst, introduced in Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon. It attacks by exploding its head, and its Mind Blown is the only signature move of any Ultra Beast. It is a version counterpart to Stakataka.
description.tagline: A clown-like Ultra Beast with a head full of fireworks
